components.instrument: K_M transfer and/or guaranteed basic services
components.indexation: cost-of-essential-basket adjusted with real-capacity and inflation safeguards

components.instrument: distribution from legally distributable system surplus
components.constraint: must not be financed by pretending nominal issuance creates unavailable real resources

anti_inflation_guardrail: When nominal transfers threaten to outrun real capacity, adjustment may shift toward direct capacity expansion, targeted services, timing changes or other policy rather than mechanically escalating nominal transfers.
distributional_rule: Evaluate outcomes using household real consumption and balance sheets, not only K_M received.
